title: lespedeza thunbergii f. albiflora
intro: Lespedeza thunbergii f. albiflora, commonly known as White Desmodium or Albiflora Lespedeza, is a flowering plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lespedeza thunbergii f. albiflora are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
